title: Keep Unicode overlap excerpts centered on the actual match
body:
Unicode lowercase can expand one source character into two. The overlap search used an index in the expanded text to slice the original body, so a reported hit could have an excerpt that omitted the hit entirely. Map that index back to the original text before taking the excerpt. Matching and ranking semantics stay unchanged.

Validation: reproduced the omitted-match excerpt on main. All 100 overlap-consumer tests pass on Python 3.12; the 5 new regressions also pass under `-O`. Cases cover long expanding prefixes, a match within an expanded character, numeric card references, multiple terms, ASCII output and title-only matches. `git diff --check` passes.

Fresh main/priorities and live PR/Discussion overlap checked. Other open fixes to this tool are this sequence’s separate cache, pagination and path-reading scopes; this PR changes only excerpt positioning. Hosted CI is pending.

Base: `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`. Verified head: `63f441c3a98e994dd99e1f1ca31199f3ef032df1`.
